summary: SEALSQ Corp, a British Virgin Islands-domiciled, Switzerland-based post-quantum semiconductor issuer, furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) updating product certification timelines. It now targets the QS7001 V1 Hardware Common Criteria Evaluation Test Report in October 2026, the QS7001 V2 full PQC Test Report in January 2027, QVault TPM-183 TCG certification in February 2027, and TPM-185 in May 2027. All versions remain engineering samples. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics apply. Watch certification slippage against F-3 and S-8 shelf registration disclosures.
